wikipediaReadEvidence.locator: Shecaniah, lines 104–106: the set-index lead says the name belongs to multiple Hebrew Bible characters, then explicitly lists “A priest to whom the tenth lot came forth when David divided the priests (1 Chronicles 24:11).”

wikipediaReadEvidence.decision: Same-name set-index entry directly matches the named priest in 1 Chronicles 24:11.
